official_public_authority.reason: Official authority snapshots are needed for source freshness and legal auditability.

public_non_official_source.reason: Public source review records are not user matter data.

licensed_secondary_source.reason: License terms govern retention and downstream use.

user_provided_confidential_matter_data.reason: Confidential matter materials remain under user/law-firm control.

synthetic_eval_data.reason: Synthetic records contain no private facts.

attorney_reviewed_eval_data.reason: Approval can be revoked and examples may have residual sensitivity.

model_artifact.reason: Model lineage is needed for reproducibility and release rollback.

audit_record.reason: Auditability must be balanced against confidentiality and deletion requests.
